column1: #dig label(central_stairwell) start(3; 3) message(Position the cursor on the central shaft tile; dig from the top floor down. The three stairs share one column so they stack into a single shaft.)
title: Central stairwell and mining level
tags: dig, stairs, multi-level, mining, starter

description: A three-floor starter dig. The top floor is a short entrance tunnel ending at a down stair; the middle floor is an up/down stair on the transit level; the bottom floor is an up stair opening into a 5x5 mining gallery. All three stairs sit in the same grid column so they stack into one shaft. Apply with the cursor on the central shaft tile. Extend it deeper by repeating the transit floor.
